readings: Using fees joined to their orders (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`) and those orders' users (`orders.userlink` = `users.userstamp`), drop any fee without a match. Compute the average fee rate (`feerate`, ignoring missing values) for each pair of orderslink and account scope (`users.acctscope`). Keep only the pairs whose average is strictly above the mean of all the pair averages, and compute each kept pair's excess over that mean. Within each account scope, rank the pairs by excess from largest to smallest. Tied pairs share a rank and the next rank skips ahead. Return every pair ranked 3 or better, showing orderslink, account scope, average fee rate, excess and rank, all unrounded.
queries:
WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT f.orderslink,
           u.acctscope,
           AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_average
    FROM pair_averages
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT p.orderslink,
           p.acctscope,
           p.average_fee_rate,
           p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average AS excess,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY p.acctscope
               ORDER BY p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average DESC
           ) AS rank
    FROM pair_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
    WHERE p.average_fee_rate > m.mean_pair_average
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3
